method: Read-only public-source research; 4 official releases + 4 system cards + 2 legacy releases + 2 benchmark sites + 1 narrowly targeted review experiment. No model calls, no subscription quota conversion. Local catalog not treated as successful invocation.

conflicts.detail: Public scoreboard Fable 5.1 40.0 and Opus 5.5 63.3 versus Anthropic 52.6 and 58.7. Public landing page/raw HTML and exact-score search checked; public run-specific fallback and environment details not supplied there. Keep separate; exact causal explanation cannot be established from inspected public data.

Current 2.0 (132 tasks) differs from launch 1.1 (Main 100 / Extended 150). Sonnet 5.5 xhigh 52.1 exceeds max 46.2 in 1.1; Opus 5.5 medium 54.6 versus max 54.4. Fable 5.1 September 1 best 50.9 differs from September 22 best 52.8; snapshot cannot be merged without underlying result history.

Sonnet GDPval 1844 in Sep28 card vs 1840 in Oct7 card; Opus AutomationBench 40.0 in Sep22 release vs 42.5 in Sep28 card. Do not combine across evaluation/rating snapshots; parent handles AA primary methodology.

gaps: No retrieved direct isolated architecture design benchmark for named models.
Research-math evidence is final-answer accuracy; no retrieved comparison of full proof soundness or original theorem discovery.
Chartography, BenchCAD and SWE multimodal do not establish visual aesthetics; design quality statements are vendor/early-user qualitative reports.
No retrieved dedicated summary/compaction/classification accuracy test supporting Haiku 5.5 small-task routing.
CodePanel medium-effort review experiment includes Opus/Sonnet/Haiku 5.5, lacks Fable 5.1 in the displayed comparison; current post omits fixture count and full harness details.
Some legacy model evidence is only official identification and historical comparison; no universal quality-retention reason inferred.

claude-fable-5-1.coverage: Official release/system card; independent FrontierCode 2.0 and TB-Science; math, tools, visual understanding, knowledge work covered.
claude-fable-5-1.retention_evidence: No demonstrated architecture or pure-math superiority over Opus 5.5 in inspected data; assess differences task by task.

claude-opus-5-5.coverage: Official release/system card; independent software, science and code review; research math; knowledge and visual task metrics.
claude-opus-5-5.retention_evidence: Direct evaluated current-generation model; broad scope but no isolated architecture-quality benchmark.

claude-sonnet-5-5.coverage: Official release/system card; independent software/review; research math and science; visual and knowledge work.
claude-sonnet-5-5.retention_evidence: Task-specific quantitative evidence, with non-monotonic effort results.

claude-haiku-5-5.coverage: Official release/system card; independent software/review; knowledge and chart understanding.
claude-haiku-5-5.retention_evidence: Official intended use includes summary/compaction/classification; no retrieved dedicated small-task accuracy benchmark.

claude-opus-5.coverage: Comparator in multiple current system cards; independent FrontierCode and science.
claude-opus-5.retention_evidence: Official default fallback for biology/frontier-LLM work in Opus 5.5 runs; Toolathlon Pass@1 80.6 versus 77.8, setup caveats and no demonstrated significance.

claude-sonnet-5.coverage: Extensive comparator in Sonnet/Haiku system cards.
claude-sonnet-5.retention_evidence: Sonnet 5.5 release explicitly names Sonnet 5 as cyber fallback; no broad quality advantage established.

claude-fable-5.coverage: Fable 5.1 system card and independent science comparator.
claude-fable-5.retention_evidence: Historical FrontierCode 1.1 xhigh Main 53.5 and Extended 64.9 versus Fable 5.1 medium 50.9/63.6 in September 1 card; attributed to scope discipline. Later card changes Fable 5.1 best to 52.8; not proof of advantage over latest 5.5 models.

claude-opus-4-8.coverage: Official release; current system-card comparator; independent FrontierCode/science.
claude-opus-4-8.retention_evidence: Named cyber fallback for Fable 5.1/Opus 5.5; Toolathlon 79.9 versus latest 77.8 in internal harness, no significance claim.
claude-opus-4-8.source_quote: It builds on Opus 4.7 with improvements across benchmarks

claude-opus-4-7.coverage: Officially identified predecessor in Opus 4.8 release; targeted legacy search.
claude-opus-4-7.retention_evidence: No verified current task-specific performance retention reason found within inspected sources.
